programme.title: I Believe In Bigfoot
programme.desc: In this first episode of the new Bigfoot Documentary Series, "I Believe in Bigfoot," Bigfoot eyewitnesses recount their horrifying and amazing encounters with the monster we call Sasquatch or Bigfoot! Witness testimonies include interviews from Turtleman of "Call of the Wild Man," Mountain Man from "Duck Dynasty," David Bakara from the Expedition Bigfoot Museum, Michael Cook who was featured on "These Woods are Haunted" and many more! Stay till the end and see never before seen footage of our own Bigfoot investigations that confirm some truly bizarre and disturbing Bigfoot witness testimony! Why are so many people telling such similar and terrifying stories of Bigfoot? Is this creature real? Is Bigfoot truly a relic hominid or is it something very different? Is Bigfoot something much more sinister?

programme.title: I Believe In Bigfoot
programme.desc: In this episode of the new Bigfoot documentary series "I Believe in Bigfoot" we explore what many people consider to be the best evidence for Bigfoot! The Sierra Sounds. These Bigfoot vocalizations were Recorded by Ron Morehead and Al Berry and have been hotly debated since the 1970’s. Television shows like “The Truth is Out There" have used these recordings to compare other Bigfoot vocalizations. Even Joe Rogan has even chimed in on the validity of the evidence of the Sierra Sounds on the Joe Rogan Experience. In this chapter of "I Believe in Bigfoot" Ron Morehead lays out his classic Bigfoot story and shares a timeline of this series of Sasquatch encounters that if fully understood and appreciated by mainstream science should rework our understanding of what a Bigfoot actually may be. What do you think? Are the Sierra Sounds the Best evidence yet for Bigfoot?

programme.title: I Believe In Bigfoot
programme.desc: In the third chapter of the New Bigfoot Documentary "I Believe in Bigfoot" The hunt for the Sasquatch begins! Filmmaker Kelley Lockman goes from documentarian to Bigfoot investigator in this installment of "I Believe in Bigfoot." The "Squatch Watchers" invite Kelley and Ron Morehead to explore a Bigfoot habitation that they have been investigating and much excitement ensues! First "The Squatch Watchers" take them on a tour of the property where multiple eyewitnesses have seen and interacted with Bigfoot. They show off their Bigfoot gifting area and the site of a Sasquatch track that they cast. Then the hunt begins! A mysterious area that "Squatch Watcher" David Martin has a bad feeling about delivers some bigfoot action. Rocks are thrown and new Bigfoot discoveries are made! Watch as the Bigfoot investigation, which would span over the course of six months, begins! Join Ron Morehead, "The Squatch Watchers," and Kelley Lockman as they go "Into the Void!"

programme.title: MechMania
programme.desc: Its the last chance for teams to secure a spot before the final. In savage and tactical 1v1 matches, teams battle for a place in the top 16. New robots join the fray, hoping for a last-minute victory to advance to the championship.

programme.title: Robot Wars

programme.title: 3 Excavators Loading Overburden + Cat 160H Grader in Huge Mine
programme.desc: In today’s ground footage, we’re at the heart of a massive open-pit mining operation, where three powerful excavators and a Caterpillar 160H grader are working together with amazing precision and coordination to move overburden and prepare the site for the next phase of production.

programme.title: Relocating The Caterpillar D9T Dozer, Liebherr 974 & Liebherr 954
programme.desc: In today’s heavy haul video, we follow a full relocation operation, transporting three massive machines from one job site to the next nearby project using a heavy-duty trailer and a MAN TGX 530 special transport truck.

programme.title: Mining Site Full Of Caterpillar & Liebherr Excavators And Fleet Of Trucks
programme.desc: In today’s video, we are inside a busy coal mining site, watching a non-stop operation where multiple excavators load coal and overburden onto a fleet of 4-axle trucks.

programme.title: Caterpillar 992K Wheel Loader Loading Cat 777F Dumpers With Aggregates
programme.desc: In today’s video, we’re inside a huge aggregate quarry, watching an impressive, high-production operation where a Caterpillar 992K wheel loader loads blasted material onto Caterpillar 777F dumpers with speed, precision, and nonstop rhythm.

programme.title: Komatsu D475 Bulldozer With Engine Failure Hauled To Service
programme.desc: After suffering a major engine failure, the Komatsu D475 had to be transported immediately to the service unit. Time was critical and the transport team acted fast, loading this giant machine onto a heavy-duty trailer and making their way through the mine's rugged terrain.

programme.title: Loading & Transporting On Site The Huge Liebherr 984 Excavator
programme.desc: In today’s incredible ground footage, we follow the full behind-the-scenes process of preparing, loading, and transporting one of the largest excavators in the mine — the mighty Liebherr 984 hydraulic excavator.

programme.title: Liebherr 974 Excavator & Cat 352F With Hydr. Hammer Loading Stone Layers In Bell B50D
programme.desc: The Liebherr 974 hydraulic excavator, a true beast of the quarry world, is loading Bell B50D articulated dump trucks with material that has first been broken up by the Caterpillar 352F excavator, equipped with a Montabert hydraulic breaker. The breaker works relentlessly to fracture tough rock formations, allowing the 974 to load fast and efficiently.

programme.title: Cat 385C, Terex RH30F & Liebherr 954 Excavators Breaking & Loading Stones
programme.desc: In today’s ground footage, we are deep inside a massive mining operation, watching a powerful lineup of three heavy-duty excavators working in perfect coordination to break and load extremely hard stone layers. - Leading the operation is the Caterpillar 385C excavator, equipped with a heavy bucket, responsible for loading broken debris onto Caterpillar dumpers. Supporting this are the: - Terex RH30F fitted with a vibro ripper, used to tear through tough rock layers - Liebherr 954 outfitted with a hydraulic breaker, smashing dense stone into manageable pieces - This combo of ripping, hammering, and loading shows how professional operators and the right equipment can handle even the hardest terrain.

programme.title: Giant Cat 5090B Front Shovel Excavator Loading Gravel On Trucks

At the center of this large-scale earthmoving operation is the brand new Caterpillar 395 hydraulic excavator, performing with incredible speed and precision. - The 395 is seen loading Caterpillar 777 rigid dump trucks with heavy material, clearing the area and shaping the land for the upcoming construction phases. With a skilled operator at the controls, the machine delivers fast, efficient loading cycles—keeping the trucks moving and the site on schedule. - This footage is a showcase of modern heavy equipment working in perfect sync to execute a high-volume project with power and productivity.

programme.title: Caterpillar 365C & Caterpillar 385C Excavators Loading Coal on 4 Axle Trucks
programme.desc: In today’s powerful ground footage, we’re deep inside a massive coal mining operation, watching two legendary machines—the Caterpillar 365C and Caterpillar 385C hydraulic excavators—working side by side to load coal onto 4-axle Mercedes and MAN trucks. - These machines, operated by highly skilled professionals, deliver fast and accurate loading cycles, keeping up with the demands of a non-stop production environment. The teamwork between the two excavators and the constant flow of dump trucks showcases perfect coordination, machine power, and mining efficiency at its finest.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.desc: Questions and Answers for the series, Break Out of the Addiction Frequency.

programme.title: The Luminescence Podcast
programme.desc: Why do women orgasm less than men in heterosexual relationships? Schuyler Grant and experts Dr. Jolene Brighten, Dr. Marisa Snyder, and Rosie Acosta unpack the orgasm gap, clitoral anatomy, arousal vs. desire, and why penetration-focused sex falls short—plus practical tools for better intimacy and pleasure.

programme.title: The Luminescence Podcast
programme.desc: Why does your libido disappear, your mood swing, and brain fog take over? Schuyler Grant and experts Dr. Jolene Brighten, Dr. Marisa Snyder, and Rosie Acosta explain how estrogen and progesterone shape your brain, especially in perimenopause, and share tools to calm your nervous system and take back control.

programme.title: The Luminescence Podcast
programme.desc: Turned on but not wet? Schuyler Grant and experts Dr. Jolene Brighten, Dr. Marisa Snyder, and Rosie Acosta unpack arousal non-concordance, vaginal pH, estrogen’s role, and common myths. Learn what’s normal, when to seek care, and how vaginal health connects to overall wellbeing—science-based and shame-free.

programme.title: Human Garage Podcast
programme.desc: How the Samurai tradition mirrors the nervous system and why true strength begins with stillness, not force.

programme.title: Human Garage Podcast
programme.desc: How identity-first change breaks loops of anxiety, addiction, and disease and why placebo beats diagnosis when you understand the hidden operating system of health.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Marci Shimoff.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Laura Kunces and Cory Greenberg on the topic of Human Powered Health

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. Lisa Miller.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Faust Ruggiero

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. In this video, your qigong teacher, Mimi Kuo-Deemer, introduces you to the etymology of qigong and the history of the 8 Silk Brocades you will practice in this course.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your Day 1 practice offers an invitation to slow down and take stock.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your Day 2 session invites you to use the tools of the at-home yoga practice to befriend your body and your breath. Build on the art of noticing from Day 1 as we expand our vocabulary with a focus on a strong foundation. This session encourages a healthy flow of energy up and down the spine and lovingly guides you to learn how to take responsibility for your experience on the mat.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your day 3 practice invites you to get to know your body through the structure of the practice and the art of aligning. We build on day 1 and 2 with a focus on action and alignment through asana and energy.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: Suffering has deep social causes. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains how your physiology is impacted by stress and social determinants.

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: The team, led by Anand, prepare for their motorcycle adventure to the four sacred peaks. The first practice ride is here in the birthplace of yoga, but it is not encouraging as monsoons are destroying roads and villages, Fred seems a liability and Ryan's seizures could be an issue.

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Jen and Jeff’s dream is to save their marriage on this journey, but it’s clear they are in different mindsets from the beginning. We are reminded that Anand himself had a prophecy of death and his teachers and life adventures helped guide him to freedom. Heading towards Kedarnath, night’s darkness sets in and Ryan sees someone Flip over their handlebars…

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Our first glimpse of the first peak, Kedarnath, the temple of death. Anand reminds us that What needs to die is part of the ego, fears, and comforts. Ken thinks people are riding recklessly, Mario takes his first spill, injuring his passenger Aizhan. Jeff ‘s comments further alienate Jen, but motivate her to rise up to greatness…

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Emptiness and Power in the Gap. The stunning Tungnath Peak at 13,000 ft, the Feminine Temple above the Masculine. Ken goes from rational doubter to having an experience beyond understanding that relates to his deceased sister. Unfortunately, the experience is tainted by ignorance and the seemingly inspiring day is further marred when Anna has an accident…

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is about the heart, but the mind shapes the story we tell. While you can’t change the facts of loss, you can change the narrative, honor old wounds, and choose words that guide you toward growth, meaning, and deeper connection to joy and healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Loss can make you feel powerless, but grief is your work and your power. David Kessler guides you to grieve fully on your terms, honor your unique process, and reclaim agency over your healing, showing that you can live fully while holding your pain with strength.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Rheta says her four-and-a-half-year marriage to Mark is headed down a rocky road, and her mother-in-law, Deb, is in the driver's seat. Rheta says it's time for Mark to cut the cord with the woman she calls deceitful, backstabbing, sneaky and controlling -- or else! Meanwhile, Deb says she hates Rheta, claiming she's violent, trashy and undeserving of her son. The tension between the women has escalated to blows on more than one occasion, leaving Mark literally in the middle. Where do his loyalties lie? Hear the drastic measures Deb has taken to get Rheta out of their lives. And, did Rheta reveal a secret in the hopes of ruining Deb's 31-year marriage? Is this a case of an overprotective mom overstepping her boundaries, or a wife's resentment getting the best of her? Dr. Phil mediates this war of words and helps to draw some lines in the sand. Whose side will Mark be on? Can this marriage and family be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Rachel, who accuses Walt of murdering her 14-year-old sister in 1985, despite his vehement denial. Walt claims Rachel might have been involved in her sister’s death -- an accusation she strongly denies. Both agree to take a polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You hear about scams all the time - e-mails and voicemails claiming you have won valuable prizes. Dr. Phil is outraged by what some scammers are doing to him, his family and his viewers. One website offers a Dr. Phil quiz to win $5,000 every hour, another says it has the official Dr. Phil personality test, but even more shocking are 800 numbers that take callers' money for the promise of over the phone therapy with Dr. Phil and Robin. But these 800 numbers connect innocent victims with con artists posing as Dr. Phil staff members. The fake staffers ask anywhere from $375 to $1,000 for consultation time that obviously never takes place.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The drama continues as Dr. Phil goes on the hunt for con artists who cheat viewers out of thousands of dollars by posing as him and Robin.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The case of missing Stacy Peterson is discussed.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to children and sports, many believe there is a huge problem with entitled athletes. Are athletes being coached to believe they are individually more important than their teams and that the rules simply don’t apply to them? Dr. Phil sits down with parents, athletes, coaches, and students who all say yes – but they strongly disagree about who is to blame. A coach claims parents are to blame due to modeling outrageous and entitled behavior. However, the sports parents in Dr. Phil’s audience push back, claiming coaches need to stop blaming them and start blaming themselves. Then, meet a referee who wrote an emotional email to parents informing them he was quitting due to their sideline behavior. And, a former all-American quarterback talks about the dark side of college sports. Plus, ESPN investigative reporter Paula Lavigne reveals some of what she has uncovered.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You’ve seen the headlines about student athletes being accused of sexual assaults and other egregious acts -- but are athletes being supported and protected by universities? Dr. Phil meets two women who claim they were sexually assaulted by college athletes and say there is a big double standard when it comes to athletes accused versus typical students. Bailey claims she was sexually assaulted by three basketball players but claims they were protected by the university. Then, Teresa says she knows firsthand the double standard when it comes to athletic preferential treatment because, even though the person who assaulted her was convicted, served time, and had to register as a sex offender, he was allowed to return to the field and was hailed as a star for another university. Plus, when an attorney claims athletes are the victims and their notoriety makes them easy targets for false accusations, he sparks an emotional debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his exclusive jailhouse interview with Kelli Stapleton, a mother accused of trying to kill herself and her severely autistic 14-year-old daughter, Issy. Were there any warning signs that she was reaching her breaking point? And, find out how you can help Issy secure a healthy and productive future.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In September 2013, Kelli Stapleton and her 14-year-old daughter, Issy -- who suffers from severe autism -- were found in the family van, suffering from carbon monoxide poisoning. Could Kelli have done the unthinkable? In a Dr. Phil exclusive, the jailed Michigan mom opens up about what happened.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In 1985, Rachel’s 14-year-old sister, Lori, was found murdered, and Rachel is desperate to prove her claim that Lori’s ex-boyfriend, Walt, killed the teen and got away with it -- an accusation he vehemently denies. Walt was initially tried for the murder, but the case was dismissed after the trial resulted in a hung jury -- and he says Rachel needs to stop pointing the finger at him and move on. Tensions run high when Rachel confronts Walt on Dr. Phil’s stage. Where was Walt the night of Lori’s death? And, how does he explain allegations that he has made inconsistent statements to police? Then, Walt says he passed a polygraph in 1985, clearing his name. Dr. Phil calls on polygraph expert Jack Trimarco to examine the results -- what are his thoughts? Plus, don’t miss Part 2, when Walt takes a new polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bridget says she is worried that her 38-year-old brother-in-law Kevin may be having an inappropriate relationship with her 16-year-old daughter, Grace. Bridget says red flags went up when Grace told her that Kevin put whipped cream on his neck and asked her to lick it off, and then found a letter from Kevin hidden in Grace’s bedroom. Kevin strongly denies having an inappropriate relationship with Grace, and claims he’s just trying to be a father figure since Grace’s dad passed away. But is there something more?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bridget says she’s not sure what to believe about the relationship between her 38-year-old brother-in-law, Kevin, and 16-year-old daughter, Grace.Dr. Phil says Bridget is a parent in denial and in need of a wake-up call. He sits down one-on-one with Kevin. How does Kevin explain his actions?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents Liz and Jim say their 16-year-old son, Nic, has a serious drug problem that has such a hold on him, they claim he even stole $75,000 in gold from his parents’ safe and spent it all on drugs! But, Liz says she is convinced that her husband is to blame. Liz accuses Jim of being a narcissist and misogynist, whose parenting philosophy is based on intimidation and abuse, and claims that is what drove their son to drugs. Jim denies Liz’s allegations, claiming she has gone to great lengths to paint him as a villain. He says she is the major problem, and calls her the world's lousiest parent and a doormat who helped enable Nic's deadly addictions.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues to speak with parents, Liz and Jim, about why each blames the other for their son’s drug addiction. Liz says she blames what she calls Jim’s abusive parenting philosophy for their son retreating to drugs, which Jim vehemently denies. Find out what happens when Jim faces his daughter, Chloe, and son, Nic. Will they support their mother’s accusations against their father?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with The Dr. Phil Family, an out-of-control, angry group with a long history of infidelities, betrayals and bitter resentments. Melissa’s boyfriend, Randy, joins the family at The Dr. Phil House, but Gene and Myra are not happy to see him. They think that Randy is a liar and a thief, and the reason Melissa has gained about 100 pounds in the last five years. Gene and Myra attempt to talk to Melissa about her weight, but Melissa is anything but receptive. Then, because they often blame each other for the chaos in the family, Melissa and Gene are assigned to bury the hatchet long enough to cook a family dinner together, without help from anyone else. Will these relatives be able to follow the rules? After dinner, a family meeting turns heated with accusations and tearful confessions. Dr. Phil joins the family and confronts Melissa and Randy about their sometimes violent relationship and Melissa’s mismanagement of her health. Can this couple create a nurturing relationship for the sake of their autistic child? Will Melissa do what it takes to gain control over her weight?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After all their hard work, the latest Dr. Phil Family receives some surprises from Dr. Phil! He informs Melissa that everything she needs to get her life back on track is headed her way: a complete health evaluation, personal trainer, nutritionist, and food service delivered to her door. In addition, she’ll receive help for her depression and be connected with a developmental disabilities specialist for her autistic son. But it all comes with a condition: Melissa and Randy need to heal their toxic relationship. Then, a talk with Myra and Gene leads to a tearful apology. And, will a one-on-one with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin, help Myra see that she deserves to be treated with dignity and respect? Will Myra set some standards in her broken marriage? Will there even be a marriage to speak of when they get home? Dr. Phil has some strong words for Gene. Next, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity pits brother against brother as Edwin and Eugene audition for a Hollywood talent agent and a casting director. Don’t miss the surprising twist when they get a call from the judges. Then, it’s time to switch gears – literally! Since Myra and Melissa never learned to drive, Dr. Phil sets them up with a driving lesson so they can become more independent. And you won’t believe the prize in store for the women if they pass their driver’s test! Dr. Phil sits down with the entire family one last time. Will they use the tools he gave them to build healthier relationships?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Recently, parents across America were googling “Who is Andrew Tate?” making him number three in Google searches for 2022, right behind Queen Elizabeth and Donald Trump. Tate claims to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. However, in August 2022, Tate was banned on social media for his misogynist viewpoints. Twenty-four-year-old Ben says when he was a teen, he had zero self-esteem, never got past the first date, and felt powerless with girls. He tells Dr. Phil that men like Tate inspired him to break out of his shell -- and he shares how. Then, a healthy debate about “toxic masculinity” with the “Godfather of the Manosphere," a scholar and author, a men’s rights attorney, and the CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Andrew Tate is known for his misogynistic social media posts and videos claiming to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. Tate is fighting a legal battle in Romania right now, but should parents worry about his influence on their sons? Before Tate was detained, Dr. Phil spoke with Richard Reeves, senior fellow at the Brookings Institute and author “Of Boys and Men: Why the Modern Male is Struggling, Why it Matters, and What to Do about It”; Marilyn York, a men’s rights attorney; Imran Ahmed, CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate; and blogger and author Rollo Tomassi. Plus, hear from a group of teenage boys who surprise their mothers when they share what they think about Tate. And, Robin joins the conversation.

Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Marriages with blended families have a higher rate of divorce than the first trip down the aisle, and today’s guests say they know exactly why. When Kip married Vicky, he says he knew that her daughter, Tory, was part of the package. Now, he struggles to get along with the 17-year- old, and they often engage in jaw-dropping screaming matches followed by a month without speaking. Hear the scathing remarks that Dr. Phil describes as the most inappropriate comments that he’s ever heard a stepparent say about a child. What led someone to fear for Tory’s safety and make a worried call to authorities? What, if any, ownership do this teen and her mother have in this family dynamic? And, Joe, 34, became an instant father to two teenage daughters, one of whom has run away. Can this family finally have a happy ending?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When he last appeared on Dr. Phil, Kip’s brazen and outrageous tirade toward his 17-year-old stepdaughter, Tory, shocked audience members and viewers. But the married father of two refused to back down. When Tory broke down in tears, Kip finally agreed to find a calmer way to express his frustration. Just weeks later, Tory’s mother, Vicky, says the surly relationship has not only gotten worse, the hostility has escalated, and her patience is running thin. She says both Tory and Kip refuse to seek help, and now there is a new bombshell that is making their home life virtually unbearable. What does Kip say is his biggest issue with his stepdaughter? And, will this family finally agree to accept help and repair what’s left of their relationship? Then, Joe, 34, became an instant father to two teenage daughters. programme.title: I Believe In Bigfoot
programme.desc: In this first episode of the new Bigfoot Documentary Series, "I Believe in Bigfoot," Bigfoot eyewitnesses recount their horrifying and amazing encounters with the monster we call Sasquatch or Bigfoot! Witness testimonies include interviews from Turtleman of "Call of the Wild Man," Mountain Man from "Duck Dynasty," David Bakara from the Expedition Bigfoot Museum, Michael Cook who was featured on "These Woods are Haunted" and many more! Stay till the end and see never before seen footage of our own Bigfoot investigations that confirm some truly bizarre and disturbing Bigfoot witness testimony! Why are so many people telling such similar and terrifying stories of Bigfoot? Is this creature real? Is Bigfoot truly a relic hominid or is it something very different? Is Bigfoot something much more sinister?

programme.title: I Believe In Bigfoot
programme.desc: In this episode of the new Bigfoot documentary series "I Believe in Bigfoot" we explore what many people consider to be the best evidence for Bigfoot! The Sierra Sounds. These Bigfoot vocalizations were Recorded by Ron Morehead and Al Berry and have been hotly debated since the 1970’s. Television shows like “The Truth is Out There" have used these recordings to compare other Bigfoot vocalizations. Even Joe Rogan has even chimed in on the validity of the evidence of the Sierra Sounds on the Joe Rogan Experience. In this chapter of "I Believe in Bigfoot" Ron Morehead lays out his classic Bigfoot story and shares a timeline of this series of Sasquatch encounters that if fully understood and appreciated by mainstream science should rework our understanding of what a Bigfoot actually may be. What do you think? Are the Sierra Sounds the Best evidence yet for Bigfoot?

programme.title: I Believe In Bigfoot
programme.desc: In the third chapter of the New Bigfoot Documentary "I Believe in Bigfoot" The hunt for the Sasquatch begins! Filmmaker Kelley Lockman goes from documentarian to Bigfoot investigator in this installment of "I Believe in Bigfoot." The "Squatch Watchers" invite Kelley and Ron Morehead to explore a Bigfoot habitation that they have been investigating and much excitement ensues! First "The Squatch Watchers" take them on a tour of the property where multiple eyewitnesses have seen and interacted with Bigfoot. They show off their Bigfoot gifting area and the site of a Sasquatch track that they cast. Then the hunt begins! A mysterious area that "Squatch Watcher" David Martin has a bad feeling about delivers some bigfoot action. Rocks are thrown and new Bigfoot discoveries are made! Watch as the Bigfoot investigation, which would span over the course of six months, begins! Join Ron Morehead, "The Squatch Watchers," and Kelley Lockman as they go "Into the Void!"

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: Isabelle tackles a great classic that brings joy on any occasion: chocolate cake.

programme.title: CHEF EN TERRE INCONNUE (UN) / AUTRES DISTRIBUTEURS CANADIENS
programme.desc: With his friend Sébastien Deraspe, Charles-Antoine Crête has fallen under the spell of a self-sufficient home in the Eastern Townships. And while ecological projects begin to take shape one by one, his restaurant, Montréal Plaza, is thriving.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: Special gnocchi, in all colours. Still accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet offers black and white gnocchi with cockles. Discovery of the day: cholera cake, a surprising quiche from Upper Valais.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: Salad takes center stage. Served with grilled beef, zucchini and corn, or made with halloumi and roasted sweet potatoes, there's something for everyone.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: "Entre Loire et Normandie, Pascal Gasnier produit du cidre et des légumes ; Antoine Debray se consacre au maraîchage. programme.title: SAUVE MA RECETTE
programme.desc: Your banana bread is completely stuck to the cake tin? Don't panic, the team has lots of ideas to save your dessert, all in under ten minutes.

programme.title: LES ROUTES DU GOÛT - LA BALLADE D'EMMA

Family encounters, local producers, young talents. The chef shares a passion for generous cuisine rooted in terroir and seasonality.

programme.title: CHEF EN TERRE INCONNUE (UN) / AUTRES DISTRIBUTEURS CANADIENS
programme.desc: In addition to building an extension with a tyre-foundation system in Abercorn, Charles-Antoine and Sébastien learn about Earthship principles by visiting Jean-Nick Trudel's home in Saint-Élie-de-Caxton. They also take the opportunity to enjoy a gourmet stop.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: Agités du bocal: lacto-fermentation and pickles. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet shares the secrets of lacto-fermentation and pickles. Discovery of the day: Manon's cheese platters, a young cheesemaker from Vaud who won the cheese platter prize at the Swiss Cheese Awards, with platters composed like works of art.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: The chef revisits the iconic fish and chips in sandwich form. A practical meal that works for lunch or dinner.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08

Dans le cadre de la lutte contre les espèces invasives qui polluent le Léman : arrachage de la renouée du Japon et sensibilisation autour de la moule quagga."

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08
programme.desc: "Annick Jeanmairet vous propose en menu des filets de féra sauce rhubarbe, et en dessert des fraises, pop-corn au caramel, mini-meringues. Découverte du jour : du kombucha urbain et artisanal, en plein coeur de Lausanne."

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08

programme.title: Robot Wars

programme.title: MechMania
programme.desc: Heat 2 of the UKs most brutal robot combat competition takes the action to Crawley in the south of England. Winners and losers from Heat 1 face fresh opponents, fighting to secure a win and guarantee their place in the finals.

programme.title: MechMania
programme.desc: Its the last chance for teams to secure a spot before the final. In savage and tactical 1v1 matches, teams battle for a place in the top 16. New robots join the fray, hoping for a last-minute victory to advance to the championship.

programme.title: MechMania
programme.desc: The most battle-hardened combat robots in the UK compete in the MechMania Grand Final. After three grueling heats, only the toughest survive. The tournament is now a single-elimination, 1v1, sudden-death formatuntil one team emerges as the victorious champion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The first of sixteen Heats in the seventh series. The four-way melees kick off the competition with true carnage. Sir Killalot may have changed the tide of battle during the finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The second round of heats sees eight new robots join the fight for The Seventh Wars title. Growler is de-muzzled as he rampages through the arena in the four-way melees, no-one is safe.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: After the four-way melees, the house robots do not hesitate to get involved with the remaining competitors. A counter-attack leads to one of the shortest finals robot wars has ever seen.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: An equal number of newcomers and veterans take to the battlefield in this episode, experience versus vigor in today’s heats. The innocent Refbot gets attacked after cease is called.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Sixth Wars champions return to the arena to battle for the Seventh Wars title. Do they still have what it takes to win, or will the competition be too fierce this time round?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A newcomer from Germany joins the UK competitors in this week’s heats. Will they put show the UK how it’s done, or will the other robots have a home advantage?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Another German joins the roster this week. One robot becomes an eviction technician, removing their opponents from the arena. Refbot joins the fray as he helps pit an immobilised robot.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A robot representing the Netherlands fights with the Brits in this heat. After attempting to attack one of the house robots, Growler makes an example of one of the competitors. Matilda uses her flywheel in spectacular fashion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One hapless robot gets expertly dismantled by another competitor, leaving Refbot to count them out. Maybe the house robots should take notes. A Hail Mary charge leaves yet another robot out of the arena.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Seventh Wars continues, eight more robots with high hopes of becoming champion enter the arena. One robot has to see a man about a dog, as Mr. Psycho and Growler team up on a competitor.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Four more stars team up with professionals to test their battle ability. Will it lead them to fame and fortune, or will they end up being thrown to the curb along with the other scraps?

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: From the producers of Robot Wars, Rescue Robots is a robot inspired, challenge based gameshow. Teams of children pilot their chosen robots and attempt to overcome pre-set obstacles, prevent imminent disasters and save Calamity City.

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: Transporter, Ranger and Talon face a potential nuclear disaster. Will the team prevent meltdown, or will this challenge prove too explosive for them?

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: The water pressure’s rising and if the team don’t get there soon the whole of Calamity City will be underwater. Will the team sink or swim?

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: A series of major fires have broken out on the outskirts of Calamity City. Will the team extinguish the inferno before it blows it destroys all in its path?

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: A satellite with vital scientific data has crash landed in the desert. Will the team be able to retrieve it safely, or will the information be lost forever?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Seventh Wars continues, eight more robots with high hopes of becoming champion enter the arena. One robot has to see a man about a dog, as Mr. Psycho and Growler team up on a competitor.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Only one team can win the £20,000 cash prize, and they could be competing in this week’s heat. A close first round leaves it up to the judges to decide who will progress through the heat.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A newcomer has an aggressive start to their first battle, with no competitor or house robot left unchallenged. Will they make it all the way to final or be punished for their hubris?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A featherweight battle between this week’s rounds. Robots that weigh no more than 12kg battle to join the other qualifiers. The main competition proceeds as evenly matched robots do anything they can to get the upper hand.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Canada and Switzerland both battle in the World Championship Qualifier special event. The heats near their end and spots for the final are filling up rapidly and to a high standard.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: It’s all-out war as Refbot is immobilised and Sir Killalot may have finally met his match. One round ends exceptionally quickly. Another World Championship Qualifier between three Dutch robots is this week’s special event.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The last of the heats, the final eight robots that have a chance of making it to the Grand Final, will they seize the opportunity or choke under the pressure? A featherweight champion will be revealed in this week’s special event.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Eight of the heat winners gather for the first Semi-Finals. With two rounds to prove themselves, only two robots will make it to the Grand Finals. Competitors show no mercy as they use any means necessary to eliminate their opponents.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One competitor’s weapon proves fatal for their opposition, crushing their hopes of a title with a single blow, whilst other unlucky robots are removed from not only the arena, but also the competition.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Grand Final is here as the series draws to an explosive end. With every battle being so well matched, the judges have their work cut out for them as they decide which robot, will become Robot Wars: The Seventh Wars champions.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Twelve Robots from across the globe once again gather in the arena for the Third World Championship. Eliminator style rounds will decide which robots progress through to the finals, where a winner will be crowned.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Let the battle for the Third Wars crown commence. With the trials being replaced with all out combat, this series is set to be the most brutal yet.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Teams from across the UK enter the arena in hopes of besting the house robots and making it to the Grand Final. The knockouts keep on coming as eight more competitors think they have what it takes to survive the Robot Wars.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Eight fresh competitors ready to prove their mettle in the arena. Featuring a special event, Middleweight Melee, a single exhibition battle between five robots weighing under 45.4kg.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: As the knockouts continue to streamline the competition, this week’s special has separate competitors trying to knock-down objects and hit targets to score the most points in Pinball Warriors.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Competitors need to hold their own in this week’s trial, King of the Castle, where they must defend a circle in centre of the arena against the unforgiving house robots. How many will survive to make it to the semi-finals?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: House robot, Shunt goes head-to-head with the competitors. It’s his job to remove the competitors from the ring by any means necessary in this week’s trial, Sumo. Will Shunt do the house robots proud, or will the competitors give him the slip?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Even more barrels are stacked up, only to be knocked down by a competitor in another Pinball Warrior. After a one-sided fight, a unanimous decision from the judges decides the victor of this week’s heat finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: This week’s special event has legs. The Walker Battle special featured robots that do not use wheels or tracks as locomotion battling it out, do they stand a chance against the house robots?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Half-way through the heats and Pinball Warrior returns to Robot Wars as another robot comes to test their aim and score against the house robots. The arena claims another robot as the knockout competitions march on.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The last robot football of The Third Wars in this week’s special. A spot in the final isn’t the only thing the heat final can offer one of the competitors this week.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The sixth Pinball warrior run introduces another competitor to test their skills against the targets, and the house robots. In the knockouts, the house robots are being exploited as the competitors over-crowd the CPZ zones.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: We see more teams from around the UK bringing in their unique, sometimes amusing, sometimes terrifying robots to battle against each other. Sergeant Bash’s flamethrower is put to good use in the knockouts.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Walker Battle returns as the contestants for this week’s special prepare to put their best foot forward against the other legged robots. A competitor makes the house robots sweat in the knockouts.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat Fishing on the Ranger 85 (Part 3)
programme.desc: Join the Stoked on Fishing crew as they travel to incredible fishing destinations, chase down a wide variety of species, and share the stories of the people and places behind each catch. Whether it’s offshore, inshore, freshwater, or somewhere off the beaten path, every episode brings you along for the adventure — with real anglers, real conditions, and no scripted nonsense.

programme.title: One More Cast — Jetty Reds
programme.desc: Lunker redfish put tackle to the test on jetties of the Mississippi River Delta in Louisiana.

programme.title: Angler's Workshop | The Perfect Hair Jig Rod
programme.desc: Jim shows you how to build a hair jig rod, with detailed instruction from one of his Signature Series rod kits.

programme.title: Fall Fishing Tactics and Tips
programme.desc: Here's how to catch the biggest fish when the leaves start turning and the water cools down.

programme.title: FishON | Northern Ontario Walleye
programme.desc: Extremely remote adventures on FishON! this season. Back to our roots with walleye fishing in Northern Ontario

programme.title: FishON | Young Anglers Tournament
programme.desc: Young Female Anglers participate in the regional Angler Young Angler Tournament

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing — Hot Bite in Baja
programme.desc: Shea McIntee and the crew head down to East Cape, also know as the gem of Baja Mexico and stay at Hotel Buena Vista Beach Resort for the fifth year in a row. After checking in, we head off for some epic tuna and marlin fishing.

programme.title: Catching Bass | Late Summer Bass Smash
programme.desc: Bass fishing in late summer can be tough, watch as Dusing shows ways to overcome the tough conditions.

programme.title: FishON! | Experience Fishing at Ole's Adventure Lodge
programme.desc: Join us as we travel to Ole's Adventure Lodge on the picturesque Whitefish Lake, just west of Thunder Bay, Ontario. In this special episode, we shine a spotlight on the Experience Fishing program, dedicated to introducing the joys of angling to children, new Canadians, and women. Witness the excitement of first-time fishing adventures in a breathtaking setting that inspires connection with nature and community.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Southern California Bluefin Tuna Fishing at Its Finest
programme.desc: Today on Stoked On Fishing, we head offshore on the Stoked On Fishing Charters 35-foot Everglades with an All-Star crew searching for bluefin tuna. We take out Okuma Fishing Tackles President Doug and John, head of product development. We also have on board Colin and his wife, Amanda from Grundens, and our friend Toby from Mag Bay Lures and Mag Bay Resort down in Baja, Mexico. This trip was absolutely nuts, with the best Blue Fin Tuna fishing we have seen in Sothern California all year.

programme.title: Wired2Fish | Baits and Gear For the Biggest Catch
programme.desc: The team from Wired2Fish delivers the goods on how to catch the biggest fish—wherever or whenever you're casting lines.

programme.title: Angler's Workshop | The Perfect Hair Jig Rod
programme.desc: Jim shows you how to build a hair jig rod, with detailed instruction from one of his Signature Series rod kits.

programme.title: Operation Fishing Freedom - Normandy Veteran Dominic Errichiello
programme.desc: World War II Veteran Dominic Errichiello saw everything from the Shores of Normandy on D-Day to the fiercest moments of the Battle of the Bulge, and is eternally grateful that he made it home to create the thing he cares about most: Family.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | A Fisherman's Paradise: Stoked on Puerto Rico
programme.desc: Join Stoked On Fishing as we embark on a thrilling 6-day fishing expedition to the enchanted Island of Puerto Rico. Nestled along the west coast, we'll be based in the charming fishing town of La Pargueta and fishing along the west coast locations of Cabo Rojo and Rincon. Get ready for an unforgettable adventure filled with wide-open offshore and inshore fishing. Stoked On Puerto Rico

programme.title: Angling Buzz - All About Swimbaits
programme.desc: This episode is all about Swimbaits, perhaps the most versatile tool in the tackle box for catching just about everything that swims.

programme.title: Hank Parker Fishing
programme.desc: Fishing legend Hank Parker take viewers to the most secluded locations for the biggest fish.

programme.title: Catching Bass | Tiny Topwater Fun
programme.desc: Dustin fishes a finesse topwater bait for bass in Early Summer

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Stoked on Coiba National Park, Panama: Part Two
programme.desc: A few years back, we rallied up with my buddy Chris Atkins who owns and operates Central America fishing. He told me, Shea, you have to do a Stoked On Fishing Charters Panama trip and fish at Coiba National Park. It's the largest island in Central America, next to the world-famous Hannibal Bank. Needless to say, we rallied up the troops and made our way down south; it's only six hours from LAX our first Adventure was incredible, and that's precisely why we're returning for our second time.

programme.title: Larry Smith Outdoors | Sheephead Smackdown

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Deep in the Northern Ontario wilderness, we team up with young angler Bradly for an unforgettable day on remote waters. The walleye action doesn’t come easy—we bounce between proven hotspots, searching for the roaming schools. But once we dial them in, the bite ignites. Bradly gets his first real taste of fishing sunken timber, battling a walleye that wraps itself deep in a submerged tree, and from there the action never lets up. A perfect day in the North.

programme.title: FishON! | Furious Walleye Action on Nagagamisis Lake
programme.desc: The FishON! team ventures to the scenic Nagagamisis Lake, northwest of Hearst, Ontario. Joined by long-time friend Sebastian Lizotte, the day unfolds into an exhilarating fishing adventure with non-stop walleye action—over 60 catches in a single day! This episode highlights the thrill of angling in Northern Ontario's untouched wilderness.

programme.title: Four Came to Kill Sartana

programme.title: Run, Man, Run

programme.title: My Name is Pecos
programme.desc: Everyone wants to know who the Mexican is. He always answer slowly, "my name is Pecos". Pecos Martinez to be exact, and he's returned to his hometown of Houston to settle up with Clain, the leader of a gang of cut-throats. Clain is busy looking for the money from a recent robbery that's been stolen from him. Soon the stolen cash in Pecos' vengeance entwine and all hell breaks loose. Behind the scenes a Bible touting Undertaker (Umberto Raho), a cowardly saloon owner, & a helpful saloon girl become part of the story. This film made Woods as internationally known as Pecos in the third world countries as Franco Nero was known for Django. A Mexican hero against a gang and a town full of gringos- what more could you ask for?

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes?
