programme.title: Lost Classics
programme.desc: Tony helps an owner move a custom Mercury to none other than Joe Zolper as a potential buyer. Then, a lead sends Tony to a dusty garage hiding a nearly untouched Porsche RS America with just 5,000 original miles.

programme.title: Lost Classics
programme.desc: Tony teams up with the Auto Archeologist, Ryan Brutt, to uncover one of the rarest Dodge Demons in existence. Then Tony follows the trail to make an offer on a movie-star, an Eleanor Mustang. With this deal, the sky's the limit!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Scott Borchetta, CEO and Founder of Big Machine Label Group, and his brother, Mark, love racing just as much as anyone. From Indy to Nashville, Ray finds he has a lot in common with the Borchetta brothers. This celebrity-filled episode features musicians Tim McGraw, Cassadee Pope and IndyCar driver Josef Newgarden.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In 1964, the United States sent a star-studded race team to England to educate them on drag racing. On that team was Bob Keith and his Dos Palmas car. After being lost for over 40 years, Ray uncovers car and puts together a plan to reunite the two once more. The restoration of the car takes an emotional turn with the loss of a friend.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Blues legend Joe Bonamassa is looking for a surprise gift for his parents. With his love of cars and guitars, Joe has to get Ray and Mr. H involved. From Mopar muscle to Mr. H’s man cave to a concert performance from Joe, this episode has a lot of Drive.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the early 1900s, race tracks built of wood sprang up across the country drawing crowds of 50,000 and more. Ray and Xtreme sports superstar Travis Pastrana break down the Battle on the Boards.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Sceriffo brings the first ever Formula Drift Ferrari to C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: A Hall of Famer?s search for an Exotic Car that fits; a blind man?s ?touchy feely? approach to seeing great cars.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane

We’ll even hear a story or two from Milton Stovesand, an 81 year old former waterfowl guide and Mack’s employee who actually guided John Olin a time or two, and ran the timber holes with Marion. programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Poppy starts to worry her whims might have consequences and brings in a scientist and a theologist to unpack chaos theory, the butterfly effect, and free will—while she processes the futility of it all. A game-show parody (“Lucky Case Game”) goes off the rails, the house band Rodent’s Revenge keeps the chaos moving, and Poppy “liberates” her beloved plants with the gift of free will. TV-14. Fictional violence and language.

programme.title: Gottmik / Mayer Hawthorne: Side Hustles
programme.desc: Gottmik launches a beauty brand, while Mayer Hawthorne shares his wine and vinyl-inspired business journey.

programme.title: Gogol Bordello: Live From Union Transfer in Philadelphia
programme.desc: Gogol Bordello bring their post-punk energy to Philly’s Union Transfer. Their explosive global punky party is on full display.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: GRAMMY-winning singer-songwriter Brandon Lake joins Joel Madden to talk balancing fame and family, using music to share his relationship with faith, and previewing his upcoming album King of Hearts. He opens up about hiring a performance/health coach for life on tour, dialing in nutrition and strength training, life on a new South Carolina farm, growing up in church and learning guitar, and the joy of community in music—from a viral onstage “Higher” moment to swapping stories about Creed and meeting Scott Stapp.

programme.title: Lost Evenings VI: Night 4 – Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls close out Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim with a sold-out, career-spanning set packed with fan favorites, sing-alongs and candid moments. Highlights include “1933,” “Recovery,” “The Next Storm,” “Miranda” and “Little Changes,” capping four nights of music and celebration.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Carly Pearce on Artist Friendly. Pearce reflects on leaving high school at 16 for Dollywood, moving to Nashville at 19, and years of grinding before her breakthrough. She opens up about trusting her instincts, turning heartbreak into Grammy-winning music, and making peace with the hardest chapters of her story.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Bobby from the British punk-rap duo Bob Vylan joins Joel Madden for an unfiltered conversation about self-determination, identity, and breaking barriers in music. Bobby opens up about growing up between London and Ipswich, navigating racism, finding purpose through education, and how his lived experiences fuel the band’s powerful, socially charged sound.

programme.title: Hey Violet: The Final Show (Live from Los Angeles)
programme.desc: Recorded live in Los Angeles, this farewell concert captures Hey Violet’s final performance together after nine years as a band. Featuring raw emotion, high energy, and fan-favorite songs, the show is a powerful celebration of their evolution from pop-punk newcomers to alternative mainstays.

programme.title: Kings of Leon: Live at The O2 London, England
programme.desc: Kings of Leon performs live at The O2 in London, delivering hits like Sex on Fire and Use Somebody in a high-energy set.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week's episode of Artist Friendly, Joel Madden sits down with Paul Walter Hauser. From waiting tables to a Golden Globe, Emmy, and Critics' Choice Award for Black Bird — Paul Walter Hauser has built one of Hollywood's most distinctive careers by refusing to play it safe. Now starring in Fantastic Four and the new Resident Evil, he gets honest about fear, learning to say no, and why being his realest self matters more than chasing the next big role.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Sam Carter, the powerhouse vocalist of Architects, for a candid conversation about gut instincts, creative integrity, and nearly two decades of building one of heavy music’s most influential bands. Sam opens up about his serendipitous bond with Good Charlotte, the “say yes or say no” mindset that guides his decisions, and how gratitude—and a little British self-deprecation—keep him grounded. He reflects on Warped Tour dreams turned stadium reality, the band’s tight-knit dynamic, and why this era is about smiling more, having fun, and bringing the wide-eyed 13-year-old version of himself back on stage. They also talk about Architects’ new album, The Sky, The Earth & All Between (out Feb 28), aiming to make their 11th record their biggest and most honest yet.

programme.title: Queen: Live at the Rainbow '74
programme.desc: Queen performs a 1974 concert at London’s Rainbow Theatre, capturing the band’s early rise with a powerful live set.

programme.title: Elevation Worship and Steven Furtick: Elevation Nights Live from Philadelphia
programme.desc: Elevation Worship and Steven Furtick perform the final stop of Elevation Nights 2024 in Philadelphia with a powerful live worship experience.

programme.title: Reggie Watts: Never Mind
programme.desc: Comedian, musician, and improvisational mastermind Reggie Watts takes the stage in Los Angeles for a performance that bends space, sound, and sense itself. Blending stand-up, music, and live looping, Never Mind explores technology, nostalgia, and the absurdity of modern life through spontaneous humor and sonic experimentation. Both futuristic and deeply human, this live special showcases Watts’ singular ability to find rhythm and meaning in chaos.

programme.title: Megadeth - Crush The World Tour Live from Buenos Aires – Night 2
programme.desc: Night two of the Megadeth two-night stand at Buenos Aires’ Movistar Arena on the Crush The World Tour. Filmed for Veeps, Night 2 delivers a blistering set of thrash classics and newer tracks, led by Dave Mustaine and fueled by the crowd’s relentless energy.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: In this surreal premiere, Poppy hits the streets of Monrovia offering eerie fortunes, interviews a survivor of the Dave Matthews Band bus disaster, and encounters Archduke Franz Ferdinand in a time-warping twist. Between absurd sketches and existential reflections, she performs a musical lesson on embracing chaos and taking risks. TV-14 (fictional violence, language).

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Poppy guides the puppets through a disturbingly enlightening lesson on “growing up,” from receding hairlines and miracle fixes to a viewer “gift” of unwanted pizzas that spirals into paranoia. A long-lost educational reel on second puberty resurfaces before Poppy and Joel crunch “life-or-death” fractions and Poppy closes with a bleak lullaby about adulthood. TV-14.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. In this video, your qigong teacher, Mimi Kuo-Deemer, introduces you to the etymology of qigong and the history of the 8 Silk Brocades you will practice in this course.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your Day 1 practice offers an invitation to slow down and take stock.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your Day 2 session invites you to use the tools of the at-home yoga practice to befriend your body and your breath. Build on the art of noticing from Day 1 as we expand our vocabulary with a focus on a strong foundation. This session encourages a healthy flow of energy up and down the spine and lovingly guides you to learn how to take responsibility for your experience on the mat.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your day 3 practice invites you to get to know your body through the structure of the practice and the art of aligning. We build on day 1 and 2 with a focus on action and alignment through asana and energy.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: Suffering has deep social causes. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains how your physiology is impacted by stress and social determinants.

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: The team, led by Anand, prepare for their motorcycle adventure to the four sacred peaks. The first practice ride is here in the birthplace of yoga, but it is not encouraging as monsoons are destroying roads and villages, Fred seems a liability and Ryan's seizures could be an issue.

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Jen and Jeff’s dream is to save their marriage on this journey, but it’s clear they are in different mindsets from the beginning. We are reminded that Anand himself had a prophecy of death and his teachers and life adventures helped guide him to freedom. Heading towards Kedarnath, night’s darkness sets in and Ryan sees someone Flip over their handlebars…

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Our first glimpse of the first peak, Kedarnath, the temple of death. Anand reminds us that What needs to die is part of the ego, fears, and comforts. Ken thinks people are riding recklessly, Mario takes his first spill, injuring his passenger Aizhan. Jeff ‘s comments further alienate Jen, but motivate her to rise up to greatness…

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Emptiness and Power in the Gap. The stunning Tungnath Peak at 13,000 ft, the Feminine Temple above the Masculine. Ken goes from rational doubter to having an experience beyond understanding that relates to his deceased sister. Unfortunately, the experience is tainted by ignorance and the seemingly inspiring day is further marred when Anna has an accident…

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is about the heart, but the mind shapes the story we tell. While you can’t change the facts of loss, you can change the narrative, honor old wounds, and choose words that guide you toward growth, meaning, and deeper connection to joy and healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Loss can make you feel powerless, but grief is your work and your power. David Kessler guides you to grieve fully on your terms, honor your unique process, and reclaim agency over your healing, showing that you can live fully while holding your pain with strength.

programme.title: The Blacklist

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Sola en un país extranjero después de que una misión fracase estrepitosamente, Katarina Rostova huye para evitar que la atrapen. Sin opciones, busca a la única persona en la que confía: un hombre que ha jurado protegerla siempre.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cuando secuestran a varios niños en circunstancias similares, el equipo se apresura a encontrar al secuestrador. Mientras tanto, Red va a la caza de un hombre que pueda encontrar cualquier cosa, mientras Liz considera un gran cambio.

programme.title: Shark Tank

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hollywood
programme.desc: Érase una vez... en Hollywood de Quentin Tarantino, nos traslada a Los Ángeles de 1969, donde todo está cambiando, y donde la estrella de la televisión Rick Dalton (Leonardo DiCaprio), y Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt), su doble desde hace muchos años, se abren camino en una industria que ya prácticamente no reconocen. La novena película del célebre escritor y director cuenta con amplio reparto y múltiples tramas argumentales que rinden un tributo a los momentos finales de la época dorada de Hollywood.

programme.title: The Raid 2: Berandal
programme.desc: Poco después de finalizar la sangrienta redada, el inspector Rama se ve obligado a infiltrarse en las filas del sindicato del crimen de Yakarta con el fin de proteger a su familia y descubrir la corrupción en el seno de su propia fuerza policial.

programme.title: Christine
programme.desc: La retorcida historia de amor de un adolescente y su celoso Plymouth Fury modelo 58.

programme.title: Armados y Peligrosos
programme.desc: Los ganadores de los Premios Emmy John Candy y Eugene Levy arremeten contra el mundo de la seguridad privada pero, por desgracia, ¡normalmente van en dirección equivocada! Cuando el torpe policía Frank Dooley (Candy) y el inepto abogado Norman Kane (Levy) pierden sus trabajos, comienzan a trabajar en la Guard Dog Security Company, donde los robos se producen justo debajo de sus narices.

programme.title: Los Angeles De Charlie Al Limite
programme.desc: Las tres agentes están de vuelta; Los ángeles están dispuestas a dar guerra para recuperar una información encriptada en dos anillos, que revela las identidades de todas las personas acogidas al programa de protección de testigos. Cuando éstos empiezan a morir, sólo las intrépidas chicas podrán detener al responsable, usando su experiencia en el camuflaje, espionaje y artes marciales. Además se las tendrán que ver con un ángel caído -Demi Moore-.

programme.title: El Arte De Robar
programme.desc: Crunch Calhoun, un acróbata motociclista de tercera, y ladrón de arte en sus ratos libres, se junta con su escurridizo hermano para robar uno de los libros más valiosos del mundo. Pero para Crunch no se tratará sólo del libro, sino al mismo tiempo tener la posibilidad de reescribir algunos capítulos de su propio pasado.

programme.title: El Libro de Eli
programme.desc: Eli (Denzel Washington), un guerrero solitario, camina en una tierra arrasada por la hecatombe; una tierra que una vez fue los Estados Unidos. Se dirige hacia el Oeste para llevar a cabo una misión que no acaba de entender del todo pero que sabe que debe cumplir. Protege con su vida la última copia de un libro sagrado que puede ser la llave para salvar la humanidad. Sólo Carnegie (Gary Oldman), un autoproclamado jefe militar que gobierna una ciudad de ladrones y pistoleros, conoce el poder que Eli tiene en sus manos y ha decidido arrebatárselo. Pero nada puede interponerse en el camino de Eli. Nada puede impedirle cumplir con su destino y ayudar a un mundo arruinado.

programme.title: Bienvenidos A Zombieland
programme.desc: El empollón universitario Columbus (Jessie Eisenberg) y el apasionado de las armas y de los bollos Tallahassee (Woody Harrelson) están a punto de enfrentarse a su reto más terrorífico: estar juntos. Emma Stone y Abigail Breslin coprotagonizan esta comedia de golpes dobles y cabezas reventadas.

programme.title: Zombieland: Mata Y Remata
programme.desc: Diez años después de que Zombieland se convirtiera en un gran éxito, el reparto principal (Woody Harrelson, Jesse Eisenberg, Abigail Breslin y Emma Stone) se reúne de nuevo en Zombieland: Mata y remata. En esta secuela, cargada de la locura y diversión que les caracteriza, estos 4 supervivientes viajarán desde la Casa Blanca al corazón del país, luchando contra nuevos tipos de zombis que han evolucionado desde la primera película, y encontrando nuevos supervivientes humanos. Pero por encima de todo, se tendrán que enfrentar a los problemas de su alocada e improvisada familia.

programme.title: Proud Mary
programme.desc: La vida de Mary (Taraji P. Henson) , una asesina a suelto de la mafia de Boston, da un vuelco inesperado cuando conoce a un niño que despierta el instinto maternal que creía perdido.

programme.title: No Respires 2
programme.desc: Un pasado violento alcanza a un hombre ciego que debe luchar una vez más por sobrevivir.

programme.title: Kung Fu Sion
programme.desc: La historia se sitúa durante el caos pre-revolucionario de los años 40 en China. Sing (Stephen Chow) es un delincuente con poca suerte decidido a entrar en el Axe Gang, uno de los clanes mafiosos más importantes de China. Para lograrlo, Sing pretende sacar dinero de los vecinos de un bloque de casas, pero pronto descubre que éstos no son lo que parecen. La banda Axe Gang acude a la zona y una serie de sucesos lleva hasta la confrontación final entre los vecinos y los delincuentes.

programme.title: Mandíbulas
programme.desc: Bienvenido al Lago Negro. Este tranquilo paraje es el último lugar en el que uno esperaría encontrar un reptil de 9 metros de la especie Crocodylus, más conocida como cocodrilo. Es en este lago donde una paleontóloga neoyorquina con fobia a la naturaleza, que ha sido enviada a regañadientes para su primera misión de campo real, se une a un excéntrico multimillonario para encontrar esta amenaza.

programme.title: El Sicario de Dios
programme.desc: En un mundo post-apocalíptico, una guerra encarnizada entre hombres y vampiros se ha prolongado durante siglos. Un sacerdote renegado luchará por salvar a su sobrina de la garras de los vampiros que desean convertirla en una de ellos. Para salvarla, este sacerdote guerrero tendrá que romper su juramento de paz, y darle caza al enjambre antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Stealth
programme.desc: Un escuadrón de pilotos de élite se embarca en una peligrosa misión. Intentan neutralizar un prototipo de avión de combate que está fuera de control y que dispone de un sistema de inteligencia artificial cuyas acciones podrían desencadenar una guerra nuclear.

programme.title: Gattaca
programme.desc: Ambientada en una sociedad futura, en la que la mayor parte de los niños son concebidos in vitro y con técnicas de selección genética.

programme.title: Mandíbulas
programme.desc: Bienvenido al Lago Negro. Este tranquilo paraje es el último lugar en el que uno esperaría encontrar un reptil de 9 metros de la especie Crocodylus, más conocida como cocodrilo. programme.title: Los Cazafantasmas
programme.desc: Un trío de parapsicólogos universitarios pierde su subsidio de investigación y decide abrir su propio negocio, "Ghostbusters", y casi de inmediato son convocados para investigar los extraños sucesos en un departamento de Central Park West. Lo que descubren es que toda Manhattan está siendo asediada por otros demonios mundanos.

programme.title: Ultravioleta
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XXI, surge una subcultura de seres humanos con una mutación genética: están dotados de una asombrosa velocidad, una increíble resistencia y una profunda inteligencia. A medida que hay más personas contagiadas, el temor del gobierno aumenta y a los mutantes se les trata como a marginados, se les somete a pruebas espantosas y se les pone en cuarentena. El gobierno ha tomado la determinación de acabar con ellos, pero una mujer está decidida a impedirlo: la ultrabella y ultraletal Violet. Gracias a sus impresionantes técnicas de artes marciales y a su capacidad camaleónica, Violet se convierte en una guerrera solitaria dedicada a proteger a su nueva raza y a vengarse de los que la crearon.

programme.title: Sicario: El Día del Soldado
programme.desc: La guerra contra el narcotráfico se intensifica cuando la frontera entre Estados Unidos y México se vuelve aún más brutal.

programme.title: Sicario: El Día del Soldado
programme.desc: La guerra contra el narcotráfico se intensifica cuando la frontera entre Estados Unidos y México se vuelve aún más brutal.

programme.title: Chappie
programme.desc: Un robot llamado Chappie es secuestrado por dos criminales, pero terminará siendo adoptado por una familia muy disfuncional.

programme.title: The Dark Tower (2017)
programme.desc: Un mundo moribundo. Un paisaje del viejo oeste, donde el tiempo no corre de forma normal, donde ciudades y regiones enteras desaparecieron sin dejar rastro. El Pistolero Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), último miembro de una orden de caballería denominada los Pistoleros, inicia la búsqueda de un edificio mitológico conocido como La Torre Oscura. Según cuenta la leyenda, esta torre es el centro de convergencia de todos los universos.

programme.title: Anacondas: La Caceria Por La Orquidea Sangrienta
programme.desc: Un pequeño equipo de investigación es enviado a la selva en busca de la versión en planta del 'Santo Grial'. El principal problema es que los poderes de la flor ya son utilizados por una hambrienta y poderosa serpiente.

programme.title: Monster Hunter
programme.desc: Un pelotón militar es transportado a un mundo hostil donde debe luchar contra monstruos colosales para sobrevivir.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: Esta aventura de acción sobrenatural está basada en la aplaudida saga de Mike Mignola para Dark Horse Comics. Llevado a la Tierra por el malvado genio Rasputín (Karel Roden) para ayudar a los nazis en su causa moribunda, Hellboy (Ron Perlman) fue rescatado por el profesor Broom (John Hurt), fundador de la organización clandestina O.D.I.P. (Oficina de Defensa e Investigación Paranormal), que lo crió y desarrolló sus extraordinarias dotes paranormales. A pesar de sus oscuros orígenes, Hellboy se convierte en un inesperado paladín del bien, luchando contra las fuerzas malignas que amenazan nuestro mundo junto a un "hombre pez" telépata (Doug Jones) y una "piroquinética" (Selma Blair). Ocultos ante la sociedad a la que deben proteger, son la clave de la defensa contra Rasputín, que pretende recuperar a Hellboy para el lado oscuro y usar sus poderes para propiciar el Armagedón.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Un grupo de documentalistas se traslada a la selva amazónica para localizar a la tribu indígena de los Shirishama. Este grupo está formado por una directora de cine, Terri Flores (Jennifer Lopez), un antropólogo, Steve Cale (Eric Stoltz), un encargado de sonido, Gary Dixon (Owen Wilson), un cámara, Danny Rich (Ice Cube), un narrador, Warren Westridge (Jonathan Hyde) y una productora, Denise Kahlberg (Kari Wuhrer). A ellos se les une Paul Sarone (Jon Voight), un misterioso ex-sacerdote convertido en cazador, que asegura saber dónde se encuentran los Shirishama, por lo que se convierte en su guía. Pero, en realidad, a donde les dirige es a la caza de un reptil único en el mundo: una inmensa serpiente anaconda de doce metros de largo.

programme.title: Anacondas: La Caceria Por La Orquidea Sangrienta
programme.desc: Un pequeño equipo de investigación es enviado a la selva en busca de la versión en planta del 'Santo Grial'. El principal problema es que los poderes de la flor ya son utilizados por una hambrienta y poderosa serpiente.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: Esta aventura de acción sobrenatural está basada en la aplaudida saga de Mike Mignola para Dark Horse Comics. Llevado a la Tierra por el malvado genio Rasputín (Karel Roden) para ayudar a los nazis en su causa moribunda, Hellboy (Ron Perlman) fue rescatado por el profesor Broom (John Hurt), fundador de la organización clandestina O.D.I.P. (Oficina de Defensa e Investigación Paranormal), que lo crió y desarrolló sus extraordinarias dotes paranormales. A pesar de sus oscuros orígenes, Hellboy se convierte en un inesperado paladín del bien, luchando contra las fuerzas malignas que amenazan nuestro mundo junto a un "hombre pez" telépata (Doug Jones) y una "piroquinética" (Selma Blair). Ocultos ante la sociedad a la que deben proteger, son la clave de la defensa contra Rasputín, que pretende recuperar a Hellboy para el lado oscuro y usar sus poderes para propiciar el Armagedón.

programme.title: El Dr. T. y las mujeres
programme.desc: Un atractivo ginecólogo (Richard Gere) en plena crisis tiene tantos problemas con su familia como consigo mismo. Por suerte, conoce a una mujer (Helen Hunt) que podría tener la solución.

programme.title: En estado crítico
programme.desc: Cuando un médico joven e idealista se encarga del caso de un paciente rico con una enfermedad terminal, queda atrapado en una red de dudas éticas y de pérfido erotismo para el que ninguna facultad de medicina podía prepararle.

programme.title: El Dr. T. y las mujeres
programme.desc: Un atractivo ginecólogo (Richard Gere) en plena crisis tiene tantos problemas con su familia como consigo mismo. Por suerte, conoce a una mujer (Helen Hunt) que podría tener la solución.

programme.title: Jericho
programme.desc: Cuando el amnésico Jericho conoce a un carismático predicador vaquero llamado Joshua, se embarcan en un peligroso viaje para desentrañar la identidad perdida de Jericho y escapar del peligro.

programme.title: Rompiendo las reglas
programme.desc: Un adolescente rebelde comienza en una nueva escuela, donde se ve atrapado en la escena de la lucha subterránea. Ayudado por un especialista en artes marciales mixtas, se prepara para asumir su mayor desafío hasta la fecha: su archienemigo que resulta ser un campeón de lucha.

programme.title: Entre dos mundos
programme.desc: La línea que separa los dos mundos de nuestra historia, nos permitirá entrar en un místico y pacífico valle donde todas las fuerzas del Universo se enfrentan.

programme.title: Jinetes desesperados
programme.desc: En este wéstern protagonizado por la estrella del country Trace Adkins, Tom Berenger y Drew Waters, un héroe solitario y una guapa tiradora ayudan a un niño a rescatar a su madre, que ha sido raptada por un forajido.

programme.title: Beyond Sherwood Forest
programme.desc: Inglaterra, siglo XII. Es una época difícil de tiranía y magia oscura. El arquero forajido conocido como Robin Hood deberá enfrentarse al sheriff de Nottingham cuando este deja suelto a un monstruo alado para que ataque los pueblos y los bosques, acabe con los hombres de Robin y secuestre a Maid Marian.

programme.title: El sustituto 3: Aulas violentas
programme.desc: Después de que la hija de su amigo es brutalmente agredida, un mercenario se infiltra en un colegio para averiguar más sobre la banda responsable del ataque.

programme.title: Desde París con amor
programme.desc: Un agente de inteligencia de bajo rango que trabaja con el embajador de EE.UU. en Francia asume más de lo que esperaba cuando se asocia con un agente estadounidense de alto rango que ha sido enviado a París para detener un ataque terrorista.

programme.title: Riddick
programme.desc: Tras ser dado por muerto en un planeta abrasado por el sol, Riddick debe luchar por sobrevivir frente a depredadores alienígenas y cazadores de recompensas.

programme.title: El sustituto 3: Aulas violentas
programme.desc: Después de que la hija de su amigo es brutalmente agredida, un mercenario se infiltra en un colegio para averiguar más sobre la banda responsable del ataque.

programme.title: The Eye (Visiones)
programme.desc: Una chica ciega recibe un trasplante de córnea para poder recuperar la vista. Sin embargo, recibe más de lo que esperaba cuando se da cuenta de que puede ver inquietantes fantasmas.

programme.title: Historias de miedo para contar en la oscuridad
programme.desc: Mill Valley, Pennsylvania, noche de Halloween, 1968. Después de gastar una broma a un matón de la escuela, Sarah y sus amigos deciden colarse en una casa supuestamente embrujada que una vez perteneció a la poderosa familia Bellows, desatando fuerzas oscuras que no podrán controlar.

programme.title: La casa del reloj en la pared
programme.desc: Un joven huérfano llamado Lewis Barnavelt ayuda a su mágico tío a encontrar un reloj con el poder de provocar el fin del mundo.

programme.title: La historia interminable
programme.desc: Mientras se esconde de los abusones en el desván del colegio, un chico descubre un mundo extraordinario de fantasía a través de un libro mágico titulado La historia interminable. El libro cuenta la historia de Atreyu, un joven guerrero que, con la ayuda de un dragón de la suerte llamado Falkor, debe evitar que la Nada destruya Fantasía.

programme.title: El ilusionista
programme.desc: En la Viena de principios de siglo, un mago utiliza sus habilidades para conquistar el amor de una mujer muy por encima de su posición social.

programme.title: Conan el bárbaro
programme.desc: Las hazañas de Conan en la Era Hiboria cobran ahora vida como no se habían visto jamás en una colosal película de acción y aventuras. Una búsqueda que comienza como una vendetta personal para el feroz guerrero cimmerio no tardará en convertirse en una épica batalla que lo enfrentará a descomunales rivales y horrendos monstruos.

programme.title: Solomon Kane
programme.desc: El Capitán Solomon Kane (James Purefoy) es una máquina de matar brutalmente eficiente del siglo XVI.

programme.title: Solomon Kane
programme.desc: El Capitán Solomon Kane (James Purefoy) es una máquina de matar brutalmente eficiente del siglo XVI.

programme.title: Wishmaster
programme.desc: Wishmaster es una película de 1997 de horror estadounidense dirigida por Robert Kurtzman, la segunda que dirigió.

programme.title: Conan el bárbaro
programme.desc: Las hazañas de Conan en la Era Hiboria cobran ahora vida como no se habían visto jamás en una colosal película de acción y aventuras. Una búsqueda que comienza como una vendetta personal para el feroz guerrero cimmerio no tardará en convertirse en una épica batalla que lo enfrentará a descomunales rivales y horrendos monstruos.

programme.title: Barb and Star Go to Vista Del Mar
programme.desc: Viaja y sal de tu caparazón con Barb y Star. De las chicas que te trajeron Bridesmaids (coprotagonistas y coguionistas Kristen Wiig y Annie Mumolo) llega Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar. Barb y Star, amigas de toda la vida, se embarcan en la aventura de su vida cuando deciden abandonar su pequeño pueblo del Medio Oeste por primera vez... en su vida. Amor, amistad y el malvado complot de un villano.

programme.title: Caravana al este
programme.desc: Un peculiar vaquero guía una caravana de regreso al Este. Sus integrantes son personas que no han podido adaptarse a la forma de vida ruda y violenta del lejano Oeste, y que sufren las últimas consecuencias en su viaje de vuelta.

programme.title: Vampire Academy
programme.desc: Una joven mitad vampira que estudia en una academia secreta debe enfrentarse a malvados vampiros inmortales y proteger a su mejor amiga de quienes quieren aprovecharse de su poder secreto.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: En el transcurso de una noche, un grupo desprevenido de veinteañeros se ve bombardeado por una serie de desastres naturales y eventos catastróficos.

programme.title: Algo prestado
programme.desc: Las amistades se ponen a prueba y los secretos salen a la luz cuando Rachel, eternamente soltera, se enamora de Dex, el prometido de su mejor amiga Darcy.

programme.title: Dónde está el dinero
programme.desc: Un joven de agudo intelecto, proveniente de las calles de South Central, debe ser reclutado en una fraternidad elitista en USC para recuperar dinero robado.

programme.title: Splendor - Una comedia sexual de Gregg Araki
programme.desc: Una mujer y sus dos amantes deciden vivir juntos porque ella se siente incapaz de escoger a uno solo de ellos.

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
programme.desc: Shannon viaja a la montaña para esparcir las cenizas de su padre, pero presencia el asesinato de un traficante a manos de una policía corrupta. Perseguida por ella y sus familiares, también agentes corruptos, está a punto de morir cuando Jack, un policía recién retirado, la rescata. Juntos deberán enfrentarse a los criminales y reunir pruebas para desenmascararlos.

programme.title: Last Man Down
programme.desc: Tras una pandemia que ha devastado el mundo, John Wood, un exsoldado, vive aislado en una cabaña en el bosque. Su refugio se ve alterado cuando María, una joven que ha escapado de un laboratorio, llega buscando ayuda. En su sangre podría estar la cura de la enfermedad, pero un grupo de mercenarios la persigue. John se une a un grupo de soldados para protegerla y enfrentarse a ellos.

programme.title: Shorta
programme.desc: Jens y Mike patrullan el gueto de Svalegården cuando la muerte de Talib, un joven de 19 años bajo custodia policial, desata la ira de los jóvenes. Atrapados por una multitud sedienta de venganza, ambos deberán luchar para encontrar una salida.

programme.title: Mercenarios de élite
programme.desc: Un equipo de letales mercenarios son contratados estratégicamente por el multimillonario CEO de tecnología Donovan Chalmers (Bruce Willis) para proteger una pieza de tecnología que, si se expone, podría destruir el mundo. Su misión se convierte en un riesgo aún mayor cuando la hija de Chalmers es secuestrada por el peligroso grupo terrorista The Pardoners.

programme.title: Vlad, el Empalador
programme.desc: Épica historia basada en hechos reales. Durante el reinado del sádico Vlad “El Empalador” 7 guerreros emprenderán una peligrosa travesía llena de trampas y enemigos, que les llevará a una gran batalla final con Vlad y su ejército. El destino de un pueblo está en juego, y darán la vida para liberarlo.

programme.title: Hansan
programme.desc: Basada en la decisiva batalla de la Isla Hansan. En 1592, el almirante Yi Sun-sin y su flota se enfrentan a la poderosa armada japonesa invasora y sus formidables buques de guerra. Cuando las fuerzas coreanas entran en crisis, el almirante recurre a su arma secreta, el barco tortuga, para cambiar el rumbo de una épica batalla naval.

programme.title: Amenaza Terrorista
programme.desc: Un agente del servicio secreto británico se enfrenta a la misión de perseguir y eliminar a un terrorista suicida nacido en Gran Bretaña y a su célula terrorista

programme.desc: Un hombre conduce por el desierto cuando unos hombres le roban la moto y lo dan por muerto. Sobrevive y deja de pensar en suicidarse, ya que ahora tiene un propósito en la vida: vengarse y recuperar la moto.

programme.title: We Die Young
programme.desc: Lucas es un adolescente pandillero en Washington D.C. que ve alterada su realidad cuando conoce a un veterano de guerra (Jean-Claude Van Damme). Encuentra en él una oportunidad única para que se convierta en el tutor de su hermano, y así evitar que siga sus mismos pasos marcados por el crimen. Esta decisión hará estallar la ira de la pandilla y la violencia en las calles.

programme.title: Pentathlon
programme.desc: En los Juegos Olímpicos de Seúl, en 1988, Eric Brogar, un atleta especializado en Pentatlon de Alemania oriental, decide desertar y fugarse con el equipo olímpico americano. Consumada la fuga, Eric se establece en Los Angeles, donde tiene una relación sentimental con una campeona de tiro, pero su relación se deteriora y acaba mal. Después de la caída del muro de Berlín, Eric consigue un trabajo como cocinero en un restaurante regentado por un afroamericano. Cuando su jefe se entera de que era un atleta de elite, campeón de las olimpiadas, le anima para que se ponga en forma y vuelva a la competición.

programme.title: Contrición
programme.desc: Cuando Tara una joven thailandesa con poderes místicos desaparece, Axe y su viejo equipo de compañeros inician su búsqueda

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: Un piloto de lanchas millonario lleva una doble vida, haciendo negocios con el gobierno de EE. UU. y los cárteles de droga.

programme.title: Elimination Game
programme.desc: En un futuro próximo, un Navy SEAL acusado injustamente de crímenes de guerra recibe una oportunidad para recuperar su libertad participando en un programa de televisión en el que debe superar en ingenio a otros asesinos profesionales para sobrevivir.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat’s voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. - One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar’s insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman’s daughter, the second one married the merchant’s daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Kids love daydreaming and show off their imaginary successes, aren’t they?! Masha and Panda grip into a real cheating competition! This would be very funny story If only all the secrets were not revealed all at the most inopportune time!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear decides to suit a big laundry in his yard, but yet he has no idea that soon he would have to pull Masha from a puddle and a jar of jam. But it’s not all- now the Bear has to sew new dresses eve-ry time when Masha will get wet or dirty.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha wants some sweets but first she has to transform the Bear's kitchen into a candy-making factory. As we all know, such sweet life means trouble and soon Masha gets a toothache. There is a lesson for all children who love sweets - take very good care of your teeth!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: A snow tower? Check. A group of friends? Check. Sound like a recipe for a fun game! Even Bear caved to the pressure and joined Masha, Rosie and Penguin – what wouldn’t you do for the sake of the children! But who will be the Princess? And who will be the Dragon? And the knight and his brave steed? Masha has her own opinion on these questions…

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: What happens when bees overeat chocolates? Masha becomes their personal trainer! Get ready! Let's start weight loss exercises!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: She-Bear is going to a resort and leaves Bear with her “pet” – a flycatcher. The modest flower suddenly shows an excellent appetite. Masha, of course, knows better than anyone how to treat the flycatcher. She-Bear will be surprised when she returns to the forest and sees what came out of such a “feeding”!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear plays checkers. Masha interrupts him asking to feed her. The Bear cooks some porridge for her. But Masha doesn’t like it. The Bear goes off in a huff. Masha decides to cook porridge her-self. But soon the porridge swells out. All the for-est inhabitants will remember this day for long…

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: When you're with your best friends, adventure is right around the corner! This time Masha and her faithful companions go on an amazing journey for pirate treasures. What awaits the brave travelers on the road ahead?

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Somebody terribly scary has climbed into the house of Penguin and made a terrible mess there! Bear rushes straight down to Antarctica to help the baby, and, of course, Masha tags along with him. Although if we are to face danger, then we must do so together!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha and the Hare are having an epic game of hockey. When the game is at its peak, Masha goes off to find the missing puck and stumbles upon a broom. Now this is much better than a hockey stick and Masha gets an idea. But it turns out the broom can be used for things other than hockey.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear has a plan to save the sweltering She-Bear> He's planned a date and made refreshing homemade lemonade from his own grown lemons. But as usual, Masha bursts into the plan. Treat the whole forest with lemonade - that's the best idea! Quiet date - that's not great! Hello lemonade fever!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Have you ever heard that the world around is full terrible plagues and diseases? One boy called Semushka knows it for sure! Wherever he threw a glance – he seemed to see tetanus, rubella and other kinds of chickenpoxes…The poor boy was so terrified that began to squish his nose even harder. The only saving measures was an aid kit which his grandmother has put in his backpack “just in case” and a little spacesuit…Basically…this grim “testament” about such a snotty boy came out to be the most educative one!

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Do you know what children are scared the most of at school? What makes them tremble?! - Here is a boy called Arkasha who really doesn’t like history lessons. The most frightening thing for him was…a history test. He tried his best to prepare for the test, however he fell asleep. When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Once there was a girl called Anya who was very scared of insects! One day Anya’s mother asked her to help around the house but in everything she did, Anya was haunted by spiders and all kinds of midges! She was on the edge of despair when her little brother proved to her, that little crumbs can’t be of any danger to giants like children!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Alert! Bear’s fridge is in danger! Someone has burst into his house to stay for life…but the Bear is ready for everything to defend his stocks! He calls for a savior, but in reality it turns to be a new intriguing story full of unexpected discoveries which leads Masha to some peculiar conclusions!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The technologies some time can teach us a human lesson like in this story about two robots. One of them was presented to Masha for her birthday and the other one was made by the Bear to help him around, but tried to become the boss. Everything turned into great mess and only an unexpectedly awakened feeling between two robots put everything in its place.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Panda- the Bear’s distant relative pays one more visit to the Bear. They start making Chinese dump-lings, but then Masha appears, with her own methods of cooking. And a simple cooking turns into a culinary master class with butterflies!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear has his birthday party. All animals come to his place to congratulate him and give some presents. Seeing this Masha decides to prepare for her own birthday so none of the animals wouldn’t have a chance to forget about her party and the list of presents.The Bear has his birthday party. programme.desc: The Wolves that live in the forest come with a plan to kidnap Masha and demand the Bear to pay a ransom. However the Bear is pleased to find Masha gone and he does not rush the events. Meanwhile Masha turns the Wolves' lives into a hell and they end up paying the ransom to the Bear just to get rid of her once and for all.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear is preparing to go on a world trip, but a last minute accident makes him panic. In the meantime, Masha knows the best way to prepare for the trip and shares it with the Bear.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha is again playing mother and daughter with Rosie. But this time an honest lot distributed the roles. Now it’s Masha’s turn to put on her cap and get in the stroller. Will Rosie endure mother's everyday life?

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Female Bear presents Masha with a glamour magazine and now the Bear shall transform his house into a beauty salon. Get ready to learn a lesson that everything should be done with a sense of proportion, especially when it comes to beauty.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The best remedy for boredom is a good game. And a good play is even better. That is exactly what our friends decided. It's just not so easy to agree on what kind of play to stage..

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one’s pains”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it’s her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf’s tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf’s tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it’s all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: "What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? Or maybe each system has a certain order? - In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. "

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha’s new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.desc: This day will change Bear’s life forever. To everyone’s surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.desc: A snow tower? Check. A group of friends? Check. Sound like a recipe for a fun game! Even Bear caved to the pressure and joined Masha, Rosie and Penguin – what wouldn’t you do for the sake of the children! But who will be the Princess? And who will be the Dragon? And the knight and his brave steed? Masha has her own opinion on these questions…

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Oh, what a ripe, sweet, and beautifully-smelling raspberry! Masha has gone picking berries, but Bear had strictly forbidden it. Now she'll do anything to avoid admitting that she disobeyed him. The situation goes too far, and everyone in the forest gets involved in the debacle. So what will the strict Bear do?

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it’s her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf’s tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf’s tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat’s voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.
